author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: The current drawing had a flat tilted slab for a cap over a pentagon face with two dot eyes, and it read as a pencil or a birdhouse. Redrawn after the reference: a tall pointed cone cap whose tip flops over to the right, straight cheeks with a round nose under the brim, and a big rounded beard marked off by a moustache line dipping under the nose.
omissions: The ears, eye ticks and scalloped moustache were dropped: no 8-unit room around the face.
